level_id_bank.verdict: Positional, LOW CONFIDENCE BY DESIGN. ARCHETYPE = post-listing / post-demerger DOWNSIDE-ONLY chart -- the operator's note: 'stocks which have primarily only seen downside are a particular type that even level-ID sometimes has difficulty finding [levels for]'. VEDPOWER is ~2 months old, -32% off its 3-Jul spike high (49.89 -> 33.73), 1H RSI 29.02, and price is BELOW all three fast 1H MAs (EMA 34.76 / EMA 35.24 / SMA 35.40) with the slow EMA (39.56) falling above. THE METHOD ADAPTATION THAT MADE THIS READABLE: the level-ID preset applied in REVERSE (0 = high, 1 = low, extensions projecting DOWN), at TWO scales, so that zones emerge where the two ladders' rungs pair. That produced a 5-SOURCE cluster at 35.11-35.48 -- and the operator's own hand-placed reference line (35.11) sits 0.03 from Ladder 2's 1.618, which is the strongest single piece of evidence that the reverse grid is the correct one. THE DISCARDED ALTERNATIVE: a standard retracement grid (0.236/0.382/0.5/0.618/0.786, 0=38.56 -> 1=33.55) was drawn and then dropped by operator decision after review -- it matched the 35.11 line only to 0.35, and below the market it offered ONE rung (30.45) before going blind, where the reverse ladders give 33.46 -> 32.03/31.49. Its 0.786 (34.62) is retained as a single supplementary rung because it fills the reverse ladders' one gap. WHERE PRICE IS: 33.73, just above L2 1.886 (33.46), with the 5-source 35.11-35.48 cluster as the first reclaim test, then 37.30-37.48, then the 39.00-39.56 trend ceiling. Beneath: 33.46, then 31.49-32.03, then the map is exhausted. NO SET-UP should be taken on these levels alone (confidence: low) -- lean on fundamentals and news until the chart is old enough for a weekly MA stack to exist and corroborate.
level_id_bank.method: Fib REVERSE application (operator adaptation for a downside-only chart): the level-ID ratio preset is anchored 0 = swing HIGH -> 1 = swing LOW so the extensions project DOWNWARD. TWO reverse ladders at different scales are overlaid on the 1H, and the ZONES are where rungs from the two ladders pair up -- plus the 1H MA stack. Both ladders verified rung-by-rung (max deviation 0.02).
